newsitem.title: USA: Whittman-Hart to acquire software company.
newsitem.headline: Whittman-Hart to acquire software company.

text.p: Whittman-Hart Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to acquire Expert Buying Systems Inc, a privately held, Vancouver, Washington-based developer and marketer of software products and services designed to help companies select application software systems.
Whittman-Hart expects to complete the transaction over the next several days.
Terms of the proposed transaction were not disclosed.
Whittman-Hart helps companies design, develop and implement integrated computer systems.
Shares of Whittman-Hart were trading off 1/4 to 25-3/8.
